title: x-relay/rag-retrieval-diagnostics
description: Relay RAG retrieval diagnostics extension for ACEF bundles. Records the retrieval document set digest, k, and per-document scores so a verifier can detect index drift between capture and replay (CLAUDE.md keystone #9 cassette-first determinism).

query_digest.description: sha256 of the canonicalised retrieval query.

k.description: Top-k requested from the retrieval index.

retrieved_document_digests.description: Ordered sha256 digests of retrieved documents (length must equal k).

scores.description: Per-document relevance scores aligned with retrieved_document_digests order.

index_digest.description: sha256 of the retrieval index manifest at capture time.
